title: Music at funerals in Pensacola
summary: There were no bands at funerals when she lived there.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Did they have music at funerals in Pensacola? Funerals? Yeah.
No, they never just have all of those bands that stay behind, you know. No, they didn't see anything?
Not at the time when I was there. I don't know what they do now.
